brief: Design a desktop inventory console for a hospital pharmacy: stock levels by drug, expiring lots, controlled-substance counts, pending orders. High-trust, used all shift. Single HTML file with realistic data.
signature: Tall Man drug names: ISMP capitals cut semibold inside the regular-weight word, hydrOXYzine against hydrALAZINE
dominance: one dominant: the drug matrix, its first row group the exception partition
